hooks.name: Format and check on save
hooks.description: Formats the saved file and reports TypeScript or ESLint errors immediately, so mistakes surface while the change is still fresh rather than at commit time.

action.command: cd "$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && npx prettier --write --log-level warn . >/dev/null 2>&1; echo '--- tsc ---'; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; echo '--- eslint ---'; npx eslint . --quiet 2>&1 | head -20; exit 0
